verdict.rationale: SavvyCal documents registrable webhooks that send HTTP POST notifications when an account changes. The docs cover HMAC-SHA256 signing, exponential-backoff retries (up to 20 attempts), a request log, and an explicit event.created event for new bookings. The rescheduled and canceled booking events the story requires are not explicitly documented in the evidence. Missing for 10: documented webhook event types for reschedules and cancellations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, webhooks notify my systems in real time when bookings are created, rescheduled, or canceled
